title: Das Speicherbuch

Rabe provides an overview of the original structures designed for storage, delving into their architectural characteristics and their place in the evolving urban landscape. He reflects on personal memories and anecdotes from friends, aiming to capture a vivid picture of life in these warehouses before major changes altered their existence.
